request.prompt: Estimate progress toward this robot task: Put the blue cube completely inside the transparent box so it rests on the box floor. Release it and leave it still. Use integer percentages from 0 to 100, with 100 meaning complete task execution. The separately supplied initial scene is the zero-percent reference. Assess each shown frame on its own visible state, rather than assuming later presentation means more progress. Return only a JSON array of exactly five objects, with exact keys frame_number (integer shown label 1..5), frame_description (brief visible description, at most 160 characters), task_completion_percentage (integer 0..100). Include every shown frame once. Do not infer hidden actions or add a task plan.
request.scope: retrospective past-frame scoring at as_of14; not prospective score at each older frame
